title: APPAREL DESIGN WITH DRAPING
description: Develop apparel from 3D form using draping methods. Advanced analysis of apparel construction related to equipment, cost quality, end use, and customer needs.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisite: DSGN 329.
A minimum grade of C- is required in DSGN 329.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman, Sophomore or Junior may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in Apparel Design (400).
